# Ecclesiastes Chapter 7 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**7:1** Better [tov] [is] a-name [shem] than-good [mi-shemen] oil [tov], and-the-day of-death [yom ha-mavet] than-the-day of-his-being-born [mi-yom hivvaldo].

**7:2** Better [tov] to-go [la-lekhet] to the-house of-mourning [beit evel] than-to-go [mi-lekhet] to the-house of-feasting [beit mishteh], in-that [ba-asher] it [is] the-end [sof] of-every human [kol ha-adam], and-the-living [ve-ha-chai] will-take [yitten] [it] to his-heart [el libbo].

**7:3** Better [tov] [is] vexation [ka'as] than-laughter [mi-sechok], for by-sadness [be-ro'a] of-face [panim] the-heart [lev] is-made-glad [yitav].

**7:4** The-heart [lev] of-the-wise [chakhamim] [is] in the-house of-mourning [beit evel], but-the-heart [ve-lev] of-fools [kesilim] [is] in the-house of-rejoicing [beit simchah].

**7:5** Better [tov] to-hear [lishmo'a] the-rebuke [ga'arat] of-a-wise-man [chakham] than-a-man [me-ish] hearing [shome'a] the-song [shir] of-fools [kesilim].

**7:6** For like-the-sound [ke-qol] of-thorns [ha-sirim] under the-pot [tachat ha-sir], so [ken] [is] the-laughter [sechok] of-the-fool [ha-kesil]; and-also this [is] vapor [havel].

**7:7** For the-oppression [ha-osheq] makes-foolish [yeholel] a-wise-man [chakham], and-a-bribe [mattanah] destroys [ye-abbed] the-heart [et lev].

**7:8** Better [tov] [is] the-end [acharit] of-a-thing [davar] than-its-beginning [me-reshito]; better [tov] [is] the-patient [erekh] of-spirit [ruach] than-the-proud [mi-gevah] of-spirit [ruach].

**7:9** Do-not-be-hasty [al tevahal] in-your-spirit [be-ruchacha] to-be-angry [li-kh'os], for anger [ka'as] rests [yanuach] in-the-bosom [be-cheq] of-fools [kesilim].

**7:10** Do-not-say [al tomar]: "What was-it [mah hayah] that the-former [ha-rishonim] days [yamim] were better [tovim] than-these [me-eleh]?" For not from-wisdom [lo me-chokhmah] you-ask [sha'alta] about this [al zeh].

**7:11** Good [tovah] [is] wisdom [chokhmah] with an-inheritance [im nachalah], and-an-advantage [ve-yoter] to-those-who-see [le-ro'ei] the-sun [ha-shamesh].

**7:12** For in-the-shade [be-tzel] of-wisdom [ha-chokhmah], in-the-shade [be-tzel] of-money [ha-kasef]; and-the-advantage [ve-yitron] of-knowledge [da'at]: wisdom [ha-chokhmah] gives-life [techayeh] to-its-possessors [ba'aleha].

**7:13** See [re'eh] the-work [et ma'aseh] of-God [ha-Elohim]: for who [mi] can-make-straight [yukhal le-taqen] what [et asher] he-has-made-crooked [ivveto]?

**7:14** In-the-day [be-yom] of-good [tovah] be [heyeh] in-good [be-tov], and-in-the-day [u-ve-yom] of-evil [ra'ah] see [re'eh]: also [gam] this [et zeh] alongside [le-ummat] that [zeh] God [ha-Elohim] has-made [asah], so-that [al divrat she-] the-human [ha-adam] cannot-find-out [lo yimtza] anything [me'umah] after-him [acharav].

**7:15** All [et ha-kol] I-have-seen [ra'iti] in-the-days [bi-yemei] of-my-vapor-life [hevli]: there-is [yesh] a-righteous-one [tzaddiq] who-perishes [oved] in-his-righteousness [be-tzidqo], and-there-is [ve-yesh] a-wicked-one [rasha] who-prolongs [ma'arikh] [life] in-his-evil [be-ra'ato].

**7:16** Do-not-be [al tehi] overly-righteous [tzaddiq harbeh], and-do-not-make-yourself [ve-al tithakkam] overly-wise [yoter]; why [lammah] should-you-destroy-yourself [tishshomem]?

**7:17** Do-not-be [al tirsha] overly-wicked [harbeh], and-do-not-be [ve-al tehi] a-fool [sakhal]; why [lammah] should-you-die [tamut] before [be-lo] your-time [ittekha]?

**7:18** Good [tov] that you-grasp [she-te'echoz] this [ba-zeh], and-also from-that [ve-gam mi-zeh] do-not-rest [al tannach] your-hand [et yadekha]; for the-one-who-fears [yere] God [Elohim] will-go-forth [yetze] with-all-of-them [et kullam].

**7:19** Wisdom [ha-chokhmah] strengthens [ta'oz] the-wise [le-chakham] more-than-ten [me-asarah] rulers [shalitim] who were in-the-city [ba-ir].

**7:20** For there-is-no [ein] a-righteous [tzaddiq] human [adam] on-the-earth [ba-aretz] who does [ya'aseh] good [tov] and-does-not [ve-lo] sin [yecheta].

**7:21** Also to-all [le-khol] the-words [ha-devarim] that they-speak [yedabberu], do-not-give [al titten] your-heart [libbeka]; lest [asher lo] you-hear [tishma] your-servant [avdekha] cursing-you [meqalleleka].

**7:22** For also many [rabbot] times [pe'amim] your-heart [libbeka] knows [yada] that also you [gam attah] have-cursed [qillalta] others [acherim].

**7:23** All this [kol zoh] I-tested [nissiti] with-wisdom [ba-chokhmah]; I-said [amarti]: "I-will-be-wise [echkamah]" — but-it [ve-hi] [was] far [rechokah] from-me [mimmenni].

**7:24** Far [rachok] [is] what has-been [mah she-hayah], and-deep, deep [amoq amoq] — who can-find-it [mi yimtza'ennu]?

**7:25** I-turned [sabboti], I [ani] and-my-heart [ve-libbi], to-know [la-da'at] and-to-search [ve-la-tur] and-to-seek [u-vaqqesh] wisdom [chokhmah] and-reckoning [ve-cheshbon], and-to-know [ve-la-da'at] wickedness [resha] [as] folly [kesel], and-the-foolishness [ha-sikhlut] [as] madness [holelot].

**7:26** And-I-find [u-motze ani] more-bitter [mar] than-death [mi-mavet] the-woman [et ha-ishah] who [asher] she [hi] [is] snares [metzodim] and-nets [charamim] — her-heart [libbah]; fetters [asurim] [are] her-hands [yadeha]. Good [tov] before [lifnei] God [ha-Elohim] will-escape [yimmalet] from-her [mimmennah], but-the-sinner [ve-chote] will-be-captured [yillakhed] by-her [bah].

**7:27** See [re'eh], this [zeh] I-found [matzati], said [amrah] Qoheleth [qoheleth], [adding] one [achat] to-one [le-achat] to-find [limtzo] a-reckoning [cheshbon].

**7:28** Which still my-soul [nafshi] sought [biqshah] and-I-did-not-find [ve-lo matzati]: one-man [adam echad] from-a-thousand [me-elef] I-found [matzati], but-a-woman [ve-ishah] among-all-these [be-khol eleh] I-did-not-find [lo matzati].

**7:29** Only [levad] see [re'eh], this [zeh] I-found [matzati]: that God [ha-Elohim] made [asah] the-human [et ha-adam] upright [yashar], but-they [ve-hemmah] sought-out [biqshu] many [rabbim] schemes [chishevonot].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "name/oil" wordplay:** The Hebrew creates a pun: *shem* (name/reputation) is better than *shemen* (oil/perfume). The sound-play *shem/shemen* is untranslatable but central to the verse's rhetoric.

**v.6 — "thorns under a pot":** Another wordplay: *sirim* (thorns) under a *sir* (pot). The crackling of thorns is loud but produces little lasting heat — like a fool's laughter.

**v.16 — "Do not be overly righteous":** This is one of the most debated verses in Ecclesiastes. EMET renders it literally: *al tehi tzaddiq harbeh*. Qohelet is not counseling immorality but warning against a rigid, self-destructive righteousness that ignores the complexity of life.

**v.26 — "the woman who is snares":** This verse has been read as misogynistic, but in context Qohelet may be describing a specific type of entrapment (possibly the "strange woman" figure from Proverbs) or using "woman" as a metaphor for Wisdom/Folly personified. EMET preserves the literal Hebrew without interpretive smoothing.

**v.27 — "said Qoheleth":** This is the only place in the book where the feminine form *amrah* is used for Qoheleth's speech — a grammatical anomaly that has generated extensive scholarly discussion.

*-- EMET*
